scope: findings of the guidance-question review of the TEST; no grade rewritten, no key signed, no prompt or scorer changed
population: every G2 question whose produced fact_type is guidance: 40 of 306, selected by the produced record's own fact_type, not by outcome
method: frozen saved evidence only - the G2 candidate cc9d51f5, its 70 served prompt batches and the whole-review input 59d54d97. No replay, no model call, no preparer imported.

controls.positive: all 40 produced quotes verify verbatim inside the very source part the record names; 24 of 24 bare level guides stating unknown are credited, and the repeated tax-rate and openings records agree across every asking
controls.negative: F4 - I disagree with a credited verdict, on the same aspect where F3 upholds the grader

findings.class: PROVED TEST DEFECT - grader is not repeatable
findings.claim: 10 produced records were graded 2-3 times under IDENTICAL evidence (same event, same source, same date, byte-identical record). 57 of 70 record x aspect cells agree; 1 is decided BOTH ways and 12 are decided in one asking and unresolved in another.
findings.why_it_matters: A grader that answers the same question differently makes part of the arm-to-arm disagreement a property of the TEST, not of the model under test.

findings.class: PROVED PROMPT DEFECT - the reply format the parser refuses
findings.claim: All 70 served G2 prompts end with an OUTPUT template whose three values are QUOTED: "<true | false | null>". The model returned quoted literals and the strict parser refused them; 93 of 141 attempts needed the approved format recovery.
findings.why_it_matters: The template asks for the shape the parser rejects, so the format failures are prompt-induced, not model error.

findings.class: YOUR LEAD DOES NOT HOLD - consistent reading, ambiguous rule
findings.claim: ULTA gold0 driver_state=false is not a grader slip. Across all 40 the reading is applied without exception: every bare LEVEL guide stated unknown is credited (24 of 24), and every unknown whose own quote states a direction or growth for the claim is refused (6 of 6). The served sentence "Guidance: movement only where the source states it; a bare guide is unknown" does not say whether movement means the GUIDE moving against its prior guide or the CLAIM moving; the grader took the second reading and held it.

findings.smallest_clarification_proposed: In the served CONTRACT, THE STATE BY LANE, say which movement the guidance state reports - the guide against its own prior guide, or the claim the guide is about - and name the guidance state set the way the metric lane already names its distinctions. One sentence, in the existing rule block, no example and no word list.

findings.class: SOURCE-GROUNDED DISAGREEMENT - a state credited that the source does not state
findings.claim: The DRI adjusted diluted EPS guide states driver_state "raised" and is credited true in all three askings. The same event's qa part states the prior guide as $10.50 to $10.70 against the new $10.57 to $10.67: the low end rises, the high end falls, the midpoint is unchanged. That is a narrowed guide, and the prepared remarks say only "we have updated our guidance" and "we now expect". Guidance movement is allowed ONLY where the source states it; the source states an update, not a raise.
